correctness.rationale: The Coxeter graph is the 28 vertices of non-line Fano triples with disjointness edges; the distance polynomials are P_2=x^2-3, P_3=x^3-5x, P_4=(x^4-x^3-7x^2+5x+6)/2. Its nonconstant eigenspace dimensions 8,7,6,6 sum to 27. Three powered-distance eigenbranches stay strictly negative on 0<=p<=1 by concavity; the remaining F(p)=(-1+sqrt2)-2sqrt2 2^p-2 3^p+(2+sqrt2)4^p has positive derivative and second derivative for p>=0 and crosses once at alpha≈0.570406337321. This gives critical zero-mass nullity 6, squared-Euclidean rank 21 (versus 27 below), and uniform Gaussian-kernel PSD precisely through alpha. Independently built Fano incidence/disjointness graph and tested full centered spectra on either side of the root; these bounded probes are not the proof of the all-real-p assertions.
